author: Julian M.
comment: I just discovered 'Thinking Big for Little People' by Ted Nadres on your page! As a father of two, how do you recommend introducing the concept of the Subconscious Mind to young kids without overwhelming them?

reply.author: Dr. Elena Rostova
reply.content: Greetings, Julian! ✨ What a wonderful, joyful journey you are embarking on with your little ones! The simplest and most magical way to introduce the subconscious mind to children is through the metaphor of a 'Magic Garden'. The conscious mind is the wise gardener planting seeds (their thoughts, dreams, and kind words), while the subconscious is the fertile, loving soil that helps every seed grow into real-world reality! When you read Ted Nadres' 'Thinking Big for Little People' together, invite them to pick one joyful seed each morning during breakfast. It transforms mental discipline into playful empowerment! Sending boundless light to your family! 🌟🔑🌱
